extraction.name: SeamlessM4T: Massively Multilingual & Multimodal Machine Translation
extraction.description: A single model that supports speech-to-speech translation, speech-to-text translation, text-to-speech translation, text-to-text translation, and automatic speech recognition for up to 100 languages.

extraction.rai:dataCollection: We used 1 million hours of open speech audio data to learn self-supervised speech representations with w2v-BERT 2.0. Subsequently, we created a multimodal corpus of automatically aligned speech translations, dubbed SeamlessAlign. Filtered and combined with human-labeled and pseudo-labeled data (totaling 406,000 hours).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Software Collection, Secondary Data analysis, Direct measurement
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 1 million hours of open speech audio data; 4 million hours of raw audio originating from a publicly available repository of crawled web data; text data from NLLB dataset.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Deduplicated audio file URLs, resampled at 16KHz, filtered out non-speech data with audio event detection (AED) model, over-segmentation using Voice Activity Detection (VAD) model, speech language identification (LID) filtering, toxicity filter, length filter, removal of pairs with high emoji/punctuation/space content.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human-labeled data (ASR transcriptions, S2TT translations) and pseudo-labeling using NLLB-200-3.3B for S2TT; automatic alignment via speech mining using SONAR embeddings.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: For S2ST, we used XLS-R based unit extraction pipeline; for T2U, we trained multilingual text-to-unit models on ASR datasets.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: w2v-BERT 2.0, NLLB-200-3.3B, XLS-R, Whisper, YourTTS, HiFi-GAN, Stopes, FAISS, Fairseq2
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Open-sourced at https://github.com/facebookresearch/seamless_communication including models, inference code, finetuning recipes, and metadata.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Gender, socio-economic status, geography, language, age, culture, experience (via HolisticBias dataset evaluation)
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Augmenting world-readiness, inclusion and accessibility for blind/visually impaired, script variance mitigation.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Gender bias: overgeneralizes to masculine forms when translating from neutral terms (average preference of ~10%); lack of robustness when varying gender by ~3%. Toxicity: low prevalence of added toxicity (0.11% to 0.21% across modalities).
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Low-resource language performance, truncation/omission in S2ST output, reliance on word-list-based toxicity detection, gender bias, limited speaker diversity in evaluation sets.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning; intended for research in speech and text translation; not for production deployment or domain-specific inputs (medical, legal).
